title: MZ Customized Message Background Auto-detecting Message Length

posts.author: _Soysauce_
posts.body:
Hi, I've been stuck for a while on this and after searching all over I'm left to nothing else but to make a plugin request thread about it:
I've been planning to use custom backgrounds for my messages, and so far I've been using Galv's Message Background MZ without any particular issues. Now, I have also decided to center in the middle of the screen all message text, and I've been using VisuMZ_MessageCore and the eccellent Naoso_EveryMessageControl with the <center> tag on to accomplish this. I'm also using EliMZ_BitmapFontPro to use a bitmap font, and all these plugins together are working perfectly fine at getting the exact visual result I was aiming for.
Problem is, I'd also like to have the custom backgrounds (in my case, comic baloons pretty much) never be too wider from the actual text shown. Ideally (but I have ZERO code knowledge, mind that) I'm picturing that for every drawn message box the actual message length is calculated and used as a reference (along with the number of rows, 2 tops in my case) to pick and use a custom background .png out of a pool - of course, I'd have to manually drawn something like 20 baloons to approximate every message length possible (starting from a simple "?" to a full screen-wide text message), but it would still look fine to me. In short, something similar to bubble messages (auto-sized to the message length) but letting you use custom message backgrounds.
As I said, I have zero code knowledge - I have no clue how feasible this would be, but I'd be curious at least to know how crazy of an idea it is - thanks!
